explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/147 (an Erdős–Simonovits conjecture) and Janzer's disproof. It negates: for every bipartite H with minimum degree r ≥ 2 there is ε > 0 with ex(n;H) ≫ n^{2-1/(r-1)+ε}. Janzer's cubic graphs (ex ≪ n^{4/3+ε'}, below n^{3/2}) refute the r = 3 instance. Restricting to r ≥ 2 is justified in the docstring.
